controls: same-gain frozen mate receives exact feedback; all references share learned motor; updating arms may collect different on-policy failures

encoder.prior: contrastive sentence training includes QA and code pairs; contamination unknown
encoder.sentence_pooling: attention-mask mean including special tokens; L2 normalization
encoder.span_pooling: mean overlapping complete non-special subtokens; no normalization
encoder.truncation: reject; caller must declare any chunking

feedback_contract: affine primary, raw candidate fallback after STOP; actual FAIL/teacher PASS pairs; RESERVED 150-offer limit in both arms; AROW with identity covariance and r=1; one fixed rank32 projection recipe, no parameter, wording or teacher-dose search
kind: public development; projected bilinear associations under AROW
resource_scope: wall time includes child waits; memory covers parent/evaluator/ledger, excluding child memory
retained_source_policy: pretrained frozen MiniLM plus external raw documents, candidate vectors, storage ancestry and immutable correction ledger

synapse_checkpoint.scope: trained synapses; ordered fixtures and receipts reconstruct storage and lineage; includes full trained and fixed-initial AROW covariance; covariance is training state, not used for inference; includes fixed projection matrices

teaching_exposure: identical prospective mixed-length sixteen-fact TRAIN; 48 encounters and teacher executions per arm; distinct common old probes and a new shared fresh cohort
